label: rem:confinement-topological-interpretation
title: Confinement = topology + action minimization
html:
The inequality L_+^2 + L_-^2 \neq 2\,L_+ L_- records noncommutativity of the length-two generators L_+ = \sigma_0\sigma_1 and L_- = \sigma_1\sigma_0 inside the two-dimensional standard module of H_3(q), where L_+ L_- \neq L_- L_+. Under the symmetric Markov-trace bilinear form G_{ij} = \mathrm{tr}_M(b_i b_j) on the six-dimensional normal-form basis of H_3(q) at loop weight z = q^3/(q^2+1), the difference v_- = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(e_{L_+} - e_{L_-}) spans the unique negative-eigenvalue direction (\lambda_-(q) = -\lambda_+(q) < 0 for q > 1), while the three-row antisymmetric sector (1^3) spans the one-dimensional trace radical (\lambda_0(q) = 0).

This bilinear indefiniteness does not by itself force optimal value 0 or select a unique braid in the linear program of 14.2.1. Because the basis begins with the unit element \mathbf{1}, the trace vector t_j = \mathrm{tr}_M(b_j) coincides with row 0 of G, so t \cdot x = (Gx)_0 \geq 0 holds throughout the cone Gx \geq 0; moreover t \cdot v_- = (Gv_-)_0 = 0 and Gv_- carries opposite-sign entries on L_+ and L_-. Operator selection instead descends to the Temperley--Lieb quotient H_3(q)/\mathrm{rad}\,\tau_q equipped with non-circular channel constraints.
